use_when: repeatable procedural knowledge should be reusable and progressively loaded
avoid_when: a one-off project instruction is sufficient

notes: Agent Skills is a file format; no framework installation is inherently required.
Place or reference a valid SKILL.md directory in a path supported by the current host.

checks: confirm the current host can discover/load the skill
exercise the skill on one representative task

steps: remove or unlink the skill directory from the host/project skill path

warnings: Host support for optional Agent Skills fields may vary.
